mobile.session_health.control_hint.note: Accessibility hint on the header's status control. It opens a sheet explaining the state; never promise an action the sheet does not offer.

mobile.session_health.menu_label.note: Accessible name of the session header's overflow button (the ⋮). Present only when the menu has an item.

mobile.session_health.menu_hint.note: Accessibility hint for the same overflow button.

mobile.session_health.menu_title.note: Title of the overflow menu's sheet. One short noun; not the conversation's name.

mobile.session_health.reopening.note: The acceptance line after Resume, and under the composer while a send to an ended session is reopening it. The daemon's engage takes seconds, so name the wait rather than showing a bare ellipsis.

mobile.session_health.still_reopening.note: Replaces the line above after the reference client's 20 s cap: the reopen is still pending, and the reader should know it has not silently failed.

mobile.session_health.resume_refused_tit.note: Title of the sheet's failure notice when Resume did not work.

mobile.session_health.resume_refused.note: The retryable Resume failure. It must agree with the button it sits under, which says "Resume".

mobile.session_health.resume_gone.note: A relay 404 on resume: the conversation is gone. Never invite a retry here — the same words this app's Past sessions screen uses for the same fact.

mobile.session_health.resume_no_route.note: Resume with no connected computer: names the missing prerequisite rather than blaming the session.
